_readme: Checks of the E2E, visual and perf gates that may fail without blocking a PR. The owner agrees to each row. A quarantined check still runs and prints its result; it cannot turn the gate red. Never delete a check to make a gate green: quarantine it here, with the date, the reason and who asked, and fix it. Rules: scripts/e2e/run.ts. Rows: { "check": "<name>", "since": "YYYY-MM-DD", "why": "...", "askedBy": "..." }
